summary: Curry County ground site: L-5 cab built 1934 on the Siskiyou NF, L-4 cab around 1946, removed or destroyed in the 1960s; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-5 cab (10x10-ft lookout house) built 1934; replaced by an L-4 cab around 1946
facts.status_note: Removed in the 1960s according to the register; firelookout.com says destroyed in the 1960s.

events.note: L-5 cab built in 1934; Forest Lookouts describes a 10x10 lookout house constructed as a fire guard cabin.
May 1940 forest plan judged the station more favorable than Mount Emily because it serves higher country.
Staffed 94 days; reported to the Gold Beach station by a West Coast Telephone Company line, with radio.
L-4 cab replaced the L-5 cab around 1946.
Cab removed or destroyed in the 1960s; the register says removed, firelookout.com says destroyed. Only the decade is given.
Registered November 18, 2010; nominated by Ray Kresek.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the L-4 cab was removed in the 1960s; firelookout.com says destroyed in the 1960s; Forest Lookouts lists the site as Removed with no date. The story reports the disagreement over the word and gives only the decade.

notes_for_editor: Removal is only dated to the 1960s, and the sources disagree on removed versus destroyed; the event uses year 1960 as a placeholder for the decade. The 2000 site photo is captioned on the register page, but no image URL was taken, so no photos entry. Access and visit facts are omitted: no source gives access rules and the brief's access is unknown. The record's coordinates (42.10127, -124.01822) match the register, and elevation 726.9 m matches 2,385 ft. No corrections proposed.
